*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage 1, Move 10, flying). *Amplified trait:* inside the swarm Notice fails at Difficulty 19 and no light carries; a canoe without a Field — Ground reading held goes where the current takes it.
*Rigidity.* The same bank, the same hour, the same crossing point to the landing, every night of Orrivane. *Exploit:* the crossing point; a net raised across it at dusk on two poles takes the swarm out of the air, and a fire on the near bank turns what is left. The keeper of the landing way did this the third night and has not needed to since.
*Layers.* Field — Geometry (Novice): the crossing is the corridor. Element (Novice): air answers at dusk, downriver. Life: a swarm; nothing else to say.
*Records.* The house-lineage's count of nights the landing was closed: two. The way-toll station's count of canoes turned: none, because none came.

**Onekura sand-monitor, Velquor 1244** — Novice · monitor lizard · Red-sand desert × Velquor: mirages · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A monitor on the salt-pan rim whose hide throws the mirage back; it takes the pan-workers' food and once a hand. Sign: a lizard that is a stone until it is not, at the rim, at the same hour.
*Block.* Guard 14 · Vigor 12 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d6 + 1 + Rank Die (Poisoned: Sickened until Reserve 13) · Move 10. *Amplified trait:* on red sand beyond 5 paces it cannot be targeted; within, attackers have Hindrance.
*Rigidity.* Basks on the rim's south lip at the hour the mirage rises and does not move until the pan-workers eat. *Exploit:* the hour; the workers eat inside the salt-house at that hour and the monitor waits on a rim with nothing on it, which the salt-house's keeper calls a fair exchange.
*Layers.* Structure (Novice): one mass, still, where the eye says stone. Life: well, cold. Field — Ground: the rim's one approach from shade.
*Records.* The Onekura salt-house's tally: a hand, and the trade across to the interior short by a day.

**Rangitahu fire-sounder, Namaris 1244** — Adept · wild pig (a sounder of fifteen) · Grassland fire country × Namaris: wildfire front · node Master-active, the fire country (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A sounder that runs inside an unscheduled fire line on a peat bed the Namaris phase keeps alight; the pigs run the front without burning and carry it into the hunting country, which is not burned by any lineage's right this phase. Sign: a fire in Namaris where no burn was posted, and pigs coming out of it.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d10 + 1, Move 12). *Enhancement:* immune to Burning; anything a member hits is Burning; the sounder's Circle carries the front — 5 paces around it is fire (d4 a turn to anyone who ends a turn in it).
*Dependency.* The peat bed, the fire's root, a mile of low ground that Namaris keeps smoldering. Found by Element at Adept grade (fire answers underfoot; it will answer next turn) or by any burn lineage, who know a peat fire when they smell one.
*Disruption.* A counter-burn around the bed, cut by a burn lineage across two days — their trade, under their right, and the smoke over Zulwazi grazing is a docket item whether the burn is a beast's or theirs; or Elemental *Still* (fire) at 16, held three turns at the bed's edge, which the lineage will call a stranger's fire on their ground.
*After.* Pigs, which the fire country hunts as game, and a peat fire that goes out in Saelura by itself.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): fire underfoot; the bed's edge. Life (Adept, contact): the pigs' hides are unburned, which they should not be; what they need is the front. Field — Geometry: the front's corridor, which is the wind's. Intent: nothing here; the lineage's anger at an unposted fire.
*Records.* The Concord docket, Threnis 1244: smoke over Zulwazi grazing, objection by the drove-line lineage, not present at fire session; burn right renewed; the lineage's note that no burn was posted, which the docket records as a claim.

**Motuweka rot-eel, Velquor 1244** — Adept · longfin eel · Rainforest river × Velquor: rot acceleration · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* An eel of the river's deep bend below a drowned tree whose bite does not close; three fishers have lost feet to a wound that rotted in a night. Sign: the bend's water black over the snag, and fish floating with their bellies open.
*Block.* In water: Guard 15 · Vigor 18 · attack +2 + d6 · bite d8 + 2 + Rank Die · Move 4 on land, 12 in water. *Enhancement:* its bite rots — Sickened, and d4 damage at the start of each turn until a Reserve check at 13 succeeds; a wound it made recovers nothing at rest until *Channel Work* or a purgative of Adept grade.
*Dependency.* The drowned tree — a snag whose wood the rot feeds on and whose reading is Velquor's. Found by Boundary at Adept grade (many small crossings, empty, in one place: the fish) or by Life (the rot sits in the wood; the eel needs the snag).
*Disruption.* Pull the snag: ropes and six canoes, a day, Frame 16, in the eel's water; or Elemental *Shape* (water) at 16, three casts, to scour the bend; the keeper of the bend way has closed it, which keeps the fishers off and does nothing to the snag, and which lapses at the Saelura turn.
*After.* An eel of the ordinary kind, which the fishers eat.
*Layers.* Boundary (Adept): fish, many, empty, under the snag. Life (Adept): rot in the wood; the eel needs it. Element (Novice): water is still there and should not be. Make: nothing here.
*Records.* The house-lineage's count: three feet. The keeper's closure, declared 40 Velquor 1244, no reading given; the Watch's observer, still on the road.

**Marama night-roost, Orrivane 1244** — Adept · flying fox (a colony of some four hundred) · Rainforest lake × Orrivane: swarm disorientation · node Master-active, the lake (Watch, from the road) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A colony roosting the shore trees on the side of the lake where the birth-moon readers stand; at dusk it rises and the lake's surface cannot be read under it, and canoes on the night water circle. Sign: the night water read blank for a phase, and the keepers on the shore instead of in the canoes.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage d4, Move 14, flying). *Enhancement:* under the colony's flight Notice fails at Difficulty 19 and no bearing holds; a canoe on the lake without a Field — Ground reading held returns to the shore it left.
*Dependency.* The roost trees on the reading shore, whose reading is the lake's and Orrivane's. Found by Structure at Adept grade (the trees return the lake's mass, not their own) or by the readers, who say the water still reads and the shore does not.
*Disruption.* Fell the roost, two days with axes on a shore the keepers have closed, which makes it a Concord matter; or Nature *The Ground Answers*, Guru work, to move the colony a mile; or wait — Orrivane ends, and the keepers' closure across the turn is how Marama was cleared in 1091, by the Watch's reading, and the Watch does not know why that worked.
*After.* A colony on some other trees.
*Layers.* Structure (Adept): the trees read as water. Field — Ground: the lake's one bearing, at Hindrance. Life (Master): four hundred, well; the lake's health, which is its own matter and the Life reader's to say. Intent: nothing here; the readers' resolve, on the shore.
*Records.* The keepers: closure declared, renewed at Orrivane, no figure. The Sedge oral record: the lake read no birth-moons in Orrivane 1244, and the Koremu-born of that phase are named for the shore.

### 3.8 Awanui — Tangata · Green Chimera · Tropical Rainforest, Evergreen, Grassland

Waimotu (rainforest river-island seat), Rotokere (evergreen lake town), Puketai (coastal hill, grassland). Ceiling Master, rising: the highest reading on the map. Ethos: Reverie, under way law. The Puketai reef is a way with a keeper since 1224 and the Passage Agreements are renewed each Threnis phase; the pilots' word on the harbor binds; Rotokere's pilots recite no tale, and the module leaves that where it is (Canon Appendix C, item 3). Seven entries and a rising Domain, because the reading is what it is.

**Waimotu climbing-crab, Threnis 1244** — Novice · coconut crab · Rainforest × Threnis: canopy predator emergence · node Master-active, the reach (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A crab of a size to take a taro basket that climbs the landing's palms each night and takes what is stored in them; it has taken a dog. Sign: three palms stripped at the crown and a claw-print in the mud below each.
*Block.* Guard 16 · Vigor 12 · attack +1 + d4 · claw d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 6, climbs at full Move. *Amplified trait:* the claw — a hit leaves the target Stuck (Difficulty 13) until it lets go.
*Rigidity.* The same three palms, in order, from the landing end, every night. *Exploit:* the palms; the second palm, with the basket moved and a spear in it.
*Layers.* Field — Seams (Novice): where the carapace breaks, at the joint. Life: well, molting. Field — Ground: the landing's one approach to the palms.
*Records.* The house-lineage's count of baskets, and one dog.

**Puketai surge-shark, Namaris 1244** — Novice · shark · Coastal × Namaris: storm surge · node Master-active, the harbor (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A shark that comes into the harbor approach on the Namaris surge along the eighth named channel and has taken a swimmer and a pilot's hand at the landing. Sign: a fin on the surge line at the eighth channel, and the pilots telling the eighth channel's story with a new line in it.
*Block.* In water only: Guard 14 · Vigor 16 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d10 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 14. *Amplified trait:* on the surge it has Favor to hit and its bite deals +Rank Die.
*Rigidity.* Follows the surge line up the eighth channel to the landing and back with the surge, and strands if the surge drops under it. *Exploit:* the channel's story, which encodes the hazard: the eighth channel dries at the surge's last hour, and the shark on it is a fish on sand. The pilots added the line at the Threnis renewal.
*Layers.* Element (Novice): water answers on the surge; the last hour. Field — Ground: the channel's line. Life: well, and hungry in the wrong water.
*Records.* The pilotage manifests: one swimmer, one hand. The reef closed no channel to it — a shark is not a hull, and the Agreements are for hulls.

**Rotokere otter, Threnis 1244** — Adept · otter · Evergreen lake × Threnis: apex beast emergence · node Master-active, the lake (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* An otter in the lake that takes fish from any net and any canoe on the water, and cannot be found in it; the fish-houses' take is down by half. Sign: nets lifted empty with the mesh cut clean, and the pilots saying nothing.
*Block.* Guard 15 (17 in water) · Vigor 16 · attack +2 + d6 · bite d8 + 2 + Rank Die · Move 6 on land, 14 in water. *Enhancement:* in the lake it cannot be targeted beyond 2 paces, holds its breath a scene, and knows every net's position in the Circle; dogs will not enter the water where it has been.
*Dependency.* The spawning shore on the evergreen side, where the lake's fish run in Threnis; the otter needs the run, and the run is the enhancement. Found by Life at Adept grade by contact with a carcass or a cut net (what it needs: the run, there) or by Element (water answers along the shore).
*Disruption.* Drop the lake a hand's breadth at the outflow — Elemental *Shape* (water) at 16, four casts, or the town's plain route, a day cutting the outflow's sill — which dries the spawning shore for the phase; the pilots have said neither yes nor no and the fish-houses have not asked twice.
*After.* An otter, which the lake has always had. The Deep Watcher archetype (Canon XI.3) is an otter on node-active water at any tier the node allows; this entry is not it and is not merged with it (register row 10).
*Layers.* Life (Adept): the run, on that shore. Element (Adept): water answers along the shore. Structure (Master): its position, and where it will be — the Overlay finds what the eye cannot. Intent: nothing here; the fish-houses' worry, and the pilots' nothing, which the Divine reader returns as calm.
*Records.* The fish-houses' take, halved, in fish. The pilots: no tale, no count, no reading.

**Waimotu fever-swarm, Velquor 1244** — Adept · mosquito (a swarm) · Rainforest × Velquor: rot acceleration · node Master-active, the reach (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A swarm from a rot pool under the island's landward mangroves whose bite brings a sickness that worsens a level a day; the seat's healers, whose Saelura rates ran past the record, have lost four in Velquor. Sign: a pool that stinks in the dry, and a house with its shutters closed at noon.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage 1, Move 10, flying). *Enhancement:* a member's hit brings the sickness — Sickened, and one level of Exhausted at each full rest instead of one cleared, until three turns of *Channel Work*, *Transfer*, or a purgative of Adept grade; the swarm does not lose Cohesion to smoke.
*Dependency.* The rot pool, standing water under the mangroves that Velquor keeps. Found by Element at Adept grade (water answers, foul, still) or by Life (rot sits in the pool; the swarm needs it).
*Disruption.* Drain it: Elemental *Shape* (water) at 16, six casts across a day, or the seat's plain route, a channel cut to the river by twenty people in two days, in the swarm; or fire it in Saelura, which the mangroves will not forgive and the healers have proposed.
*After.* Mosquitoes, which the island has always had, at the island's rate of sickness.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): foul water, still. Life (Adept): rot in the pool; the sickness in a patient, where it sits and what it needs, which is *Channel Work*. Make: nothing here, and the healers asked. Boundary: four, this phase, confused.
*Records.* The healers' count: four. The Ledger's Puketai estimate: nothing upriver of the pilot's last mark.

**Puketai hill-sounder, Saelura 1244** — Adept · wild pig (a sounder of twenty) · Grassland × Saelura: soil recovery · node Master-active, the hill (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A sounder rooting a strip of the coastal hill where the Saelura soil came back a hand deep in a night; what it roots regrows by morning and the sounder is never hungry and never tired. Sign: a strip of the hill rooted and green at once.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d10 + 1, Move 10). *Enhancement:* on the recovered strip the sounder regains full Cohesion at the start of each of its turns and does not lose Cohesion to fear; off it, it is pigs.
*Dependency.* The strip, three hundred paces of hillside whose soil reads Saelura's. Found by Element at Adept grade (ground answers; the soil is the thing) or by Life (the strip's health is past a soil's; the sounder needs it).
*Disruption.* Salt the strip — the pilots' salt from Onekura, a cart, a day; or burn it, which is fire on a hill Awanui holds no burn right over; or Elemental *Shape* (ground) at 16, four casts, to turn the topsoil under. The house-lineage has salted the top hundred paces and the sounder has moved down.
*After.* Pigs on a hill, which the pilots hunt.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): ground answers on the strip. Life (Adept): the strip, past a soil's health. Field — Geometry: the sounder's corridor, along the strip. Field — Nerve: holds on the strip, breaks off it.
*Records.* The pilotage manifests: pig-hides, up. The house-lineage: the strip's length, in paces, salted and not.

**Puketai fire-harrier, Namaris 1244** — Master · harrier · Grassland (Coastal overlay) × Namaris: wildfire front; storm surge · node Master-active, the hill and the harbor (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A harrier of a size the hill has no record of that carries fire. It takes a burning stick from a front's edge in its talons and drops it a hundred paces ahead in unburned grass, and hunts what runs from the new front; the hill has burned through Namaris 1244 in front after front and the fronts run to the sea, and the harbor's pilotage is under smoke for days at a time. The pilots say the harbor reads as it should. Sign: a fire front on the hill with no lightning and no burn posted, a second front starting ahead of it, and a bird over both.
*Block.* Large for a bird: Guard 15 (17 in Dominance) · Vigor 28 · attack +3 + d8 · talon d10 + 3 + Rank Die · Move 16, flying. *Dominance:* on the hill, and wherever a front it has lit is burning, the harrier is concealed in smoke, its attacks have Favor, it regains all Vigor at the start of its turn, the numbers rule does not apply, and Guard is +2. The ground expresses the cell: a wildfire front stands wherever it hunts — anyone who ends a turn in the front is Burning; the front moves 6 paces a turn with the wind; Notice at Hindrance under the smoke; the harbor approach under it has Storm surge as well (Coastal × Namaris), which the pilots handle and the Accord's captains do not.
*Energy inversion.* Its dominance is the fuel's. A hill with no grass has no front, and a phase turn to Saelura is a hill whose soil recovers under the ash and will not carry fire for a phase. The harrier feels the turn coming and burns hardest at the phase's end.
*Reversal.* A counter-burn of the whole hill, executed across the phase turn: fuel removed ahead of the harrier so that no front it lights can run. Awanui holds no burn rights. The Rangitahu lineages of Koremu do, and lend them and never sell them; the lending is asked at the Concord and given or not by the lineage, and the smoke goes where it goes. Identified by Element at Master grade at 22 (the hill's fire lines entire; where the wind takes each) or by Life at Master grade (the harrier's need, which is the front; the hill's health, which is the fuel) — each alone gives half; the Join of the two at 22 + 22 gives the burn plan. The last act: the lineage's burners hold their line across the hill's crest against the harrier's fronts for a scene, while the party holds the burners, in smoke, against a bird that comes down out of it.
*After.* A Master block over bare ash, Guard 15, Vigor 28, no smoke, no regaining, no Favor. It fights over the landing, because that is where the last thing that burns is.
*Layers.* Element (Master): every fire line on the hill and the surge in the approach; each's next turn. Life (Master): the harrier, the game running ahead of it, the hill's fuel load as a health. Structure (Master): its mass and where it will be next turn — the one reading that gives a shooter the bird in smoke. Field — Ground (Master): every approach to the crest, all of them under smoke. Field — Nerve: it holds; it does not break for fire, being the fire's. Boundary (Adept): game, many, burned; one child, Namaris, confused. Intent: nothing here; the pilots' calm, which is a navigator's word and binds.
*Records.* The Puketai pilotage manifests: eleven sailing days lost to smoke in Namaris 1244, by the harbor's count. The Ledger's Puketai estimate: nineteen, from the same manifests, because the Ledger counts the days the manifests say the pilots waited and the pilots count the days they could not sail. The Concord: a request for burn rights on Awanui ground, entered by the Waimotu council, deferred to the Threnis turn. The Watch: the hill at Master since Namaris.

**Waimotu reach, rising — Threnis 1244** — Guru tier, rising · base animal not recorded (the council: a keeper; the Namarite Tithe's shrine at Waimotu: the Sower's work; the Ledger's Puketai estimate: a reading) · Tropical Rainforest × Threnis: canopy predator emergence, at full expression · node off the Watch's scale at the Threnis 1244 turn, rising at Velquor 1245 · Reverie ground.
*Watch entry (Appendix D form).* Threnis 1244. "Canopy over the Waimotu reach read past the scale at the turn. Keepers posted closure. Reading rising at Velquor." Place and tether: the forest reach above the river-island seat; the reach. Phase: Threnis, at the turn. Reading at rising: off the Watch's scale, as Frostvatn was. How displaced: not yet. Other record: the Waimotu council's closure, declared at the turn, renewed at Velquor, no figure given; the Tithe's shrine-keeper's letter to Qasr-Al-Rimal, unanswered.
*Status.* Rising; not risen as of 1 Velquor 1245. The GM decides whether and when it rises; the standing assessment of the Watch is that Frostvatn was the decade's largest expression and not its conclusion (Canon Part IX, The Present), and this is the module's candidate for the next. A campaign event; a season of play. If it never rises, the reach stays closed, the reading stays off the scale, and the entry stays an entry (Canon Appendix D, rule for episodes: a fifth entry may be added only as an entry).
*Domain, if it rises.* The reach: the rainforest above Waimotu from the seat's landing to the first falls, and the river through it. Standing conditions at Ground scale: canopy predator emergence at full expression — every beast on the reach is one tier above its entry, to Master; the canopy closes paths behind anyone on them (a way that has a keeper now — Field — Geometry returns a corridor that was not there and is); rapid healing beyond record for any Nature technique used on the reach (*Channel Work* restores double), which is the Saelura anomaly of 1218 made standing; Nature Novices take 1 Environmental Strain at the start of each turn spent reading on the reach, and every Life reading returns one grade more in facts at the reader's own scale. The seat is not in the Domain; the seat is where the Domain ends, and the households have moved their landing to the seaward side.
*Tether.* The reach's node: the bend of the river above the seat where the forest stands on both banks and the water runs slow. Structure at Guru grade returns its two editable values. It is not the seat and it is not the reef.
*Displacement.* By closure (Chimera): the council's closure of the reach held empty across two phase turns and renewed at each — the Marama method of 1091, which the Watch records as having worked and cannot say why; nothing enters the reach, including the Tithe's collectors, who owe the way-toll and would pay it. By engineering (Accord): the Ledger's Puketai estimate does not reach upriver of the pilot's last mark, and the Accord has no charter on the reach; an engineering displacement would be an Accord operation on Chimera ground under no treaty, which is a plot and not a rule. Either method ends in a Join at 30 at the bend: Life at 22 (Nature Guru, *The Ground Answers*: the reach entire, and what it needs, which is to be left) and Structure at 22 (Arcane, *Overlay at Ground*: the anchor's two values, and which to unseat), or Life and Boundary (Necrotic *Read at Ground*: every crossing on the reach since the turn, which is the account the keepers' closure is keeping). The Domain collapses on the success. Nothing is killed.
*Records.* The council's closure. The Tithe's letter. The Ledger's estimate, which stops at the mark. The Sedge oral record, asked, says the reach has always had a keeper and now it is awake, which the Ledger classifies as anecdotal and the pilots decline to comment on. Three accounts of one reading; the rule for episodes is that no one settles it (Canon XI.6, lunar embodiments vs gods).

### 3.9 Yaxkulu — Yamana · Green Chimera · Deciduous Forest, Grassland, Desert

Witzmul (forest hill seat), Sakbeha (grassland causeway town), Kinha (desert well settlement). Ceiling Adept. Ethos: Reverie, under road law and duty inheritance. Ash-and-Antler's warding assessment is the count the Accord buys as a census; it counts what the compact wards and does not ward the Kinha wells. A beast on a causeway is a road-law matter: blood on the road owes double, and the road-keeping lineage whose stretch it is has the duty, which may be older than anyone living.

**Witzmul terrace-deer, Saelura 1244** — Novice · white-tailed deer, buck · Deciduous forest × Saelura: rapid healing · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A buck that browses the maize on the terrace walls after the road-sweeping and has been arrowed three times without going down. Sign: terrace maize cropped to one height at dusk, and an arrow in the wall.
*Block.* Guard 13 · Vigor 14 · attack +1 + d4 · antler d6 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 14. *Amplified trait:* regains d4 Vigor at the start of each turn; Move 14.
*Rigidity.* The same terrace at the same hour after the sweeping, and it leaves by the same gap in the wall. *Exploit:* the gap, closed with a hurdle during the sweeping; the buck stands at it until the arrow that goes in before it regains.
*Layers.* Life (Novice): well; no wound. Field — Ground: the gap. Field — Weight: it commits to the maize, not the archer.
*Records.* The terrace lineage's duty roll: maize lost, in the terrace's tithe to the road.

**Kinha well-coyote, Velquor 1244** — Novice · coyote · Desert × Velquor: mirages · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A coyote that circles the desert well at a fixed distance under the mirage and takes kids and hens from the compounds. Sign: a coyote seen twice, in two places, at once.
*Block.* Small: Guard 15 · Vigor 8 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d4 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12. *Amplified trait:* in Velquor beyond 10 paces it cannot be targeted; within, attackers have Hindrance.
*Rigidity.* Circles the well at forty paces exactly and never closer while anyone draws. *Exploit:* draw water; the circle holds while the bucket moves, and a second archer at forty paces on the far side is on the circle. Ash-and-Antler does not ward Kinha; the well settlement's own count is the record.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the distance, exact. Structure (Novice): one mass, where two are seen. Life: thin.
*Records.* The compounds' count: four kids, nine hens. The compact's assessment: no entry.

**Sakbeha causeway-hawk, Threnis 1244** — Novice · red-tailed hawk · Grassland × Threnis: burrow and raptor apex · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A hawk that hunts the white causeway's line and stoops at noon on anything crossing it; it has taken a runner's knotted cord from her hand. Sign: a hawk over the road at noon and nothing else on it.
*Block.* Guard 15 · Vigor 10 · attack +1 + d4 · talon d6 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 16, flying. *Amplified trait:* from above, its attack has Favor and deals +Rank Die.
*Rigidity.* The causeway's line only, at noon, from the sun. *Exploit:* the culverts — where the drove-lines cross under the road, a runner passes under the hawk's line; the runner lineages have changed their noon crossings and the road-keeping lineage counts the culverts' upkeep against them, annually, as the argument it always was.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the road is its ground; the culvert is not. Field — Weight: it commits at noon. Life: well.
*Records.* The runner lineage's count: one cord, its knots. The compact's assessment: a hawk.

**Witzmul step-ocelot, Threnis 1244** — Novice · ocelot · Deciduous forest × Threnis: apex beast emergence · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* An ocelot in the seat's forest that kills at night and leaves every kill on the top step of the terrace wall below the seat. Sign: a hen, a cat, a dog's pup on the same step at dawn.
*Block.* Small: Guard 15 · Vigor 8 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d4 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12, climbs at full Move. *Amplified trait:* at night it cannot be Noticed beyond 5 paces and is never Surprised.
*Rigidity.* The kill goes to the top step, every time, and it comes back for it before dawn. *Exploit:* the step, with a net over it and a Warden on *Watch* on the wall.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the approach to the step, one, from the forest edge. Boundary (Novice): small crossings, many, here. Life: well.
*Records.* The seat's households: eleven small animals. No claim; an ocelot is a nuisance.

**Kinha lining-armadillo, Threnis 1244** — Novice · armadillo · Desert × Threnis: burrow dominance · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* An armadillo that digs under the well's lining toward the water and collapses a course of stones a phase. Sign: a course sagged on the east side and a burrow under it.
*Block.* Small: Guard 16 · Vigor 8 · attack +1 + d4 · claw d4 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 6, burrows 4. *Amplified trait:* ignores the first 3 damage of any hit; digs through packed earth at full burrowing Move.
*Rigidity.* Digs toward water only, from the nearest dry ground, and stops at any water it reaches. *Exploit:* a decoy seep — a bucket poured into a trench on the east side each evening, which it digs toward and stops at. A day to cut the trench.
*Layers.* Element (Novice): water answers, below, and the armadillo knows where. Field — Seams: the course that gives.
*Records.* The well settlement's count of courses, in labor-days.

**Sakbeha culvert-peccaries, Orrivane 1244** — Adept · collared peccary (a herd of thirty) · Grassland causeway × Orrivane: herd agitation · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* A herd that wallows in a causeway culvert and whose scent under the road sends pack llamas and porters' loads off it; four loads lost in the causeway's ditch this phase, and a porter's leg. Sign: a culvert with a wallow in it and llamas that will not cross the road above.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d8 + 1, Move 10). *Enhancement:* pack animals and mounts within 30 paces of the culvert bolt on a Reserve check at 13 at the start of their turn; a load dropped in the ditch is a load.
*Dependency.* The culvert: its keystone reads Orrivane-active and the wallow is under it. Found by Structure at Adept grade (a shape whose position drifts, in the arch) or by the road-keeping lineage, whose duty the culvert is and who have measured it twice this year.
*Disruption.* Re-lay the culvert — a phase of road duty by the lineage that owes it, which it does; or Arcane *Precise Force* on the keystone at 16, three successes, which the lineage will read as blood on the road if it comes to a fight there, and it will.
*After.* Peccaries in a culvert, which the drove-lines push through.
*Layers.* Structure (Adept): the keystone drifts a pace. Field — Geometry: the culvert is the hinge; the road above is the corridor. Life: thirty, well. Intent: nothing here; the porters' fear, at the ditch.
*Records.* The road-keeping lineage's duty roll. Ash-and-Antler's assessment, which wards the causeway and counts four loads.

**Witzmul smolder-roost, Namaris 1244** — Adept · bat (a colony in a burned hill cave) · Deciduous forest × Namaris: fire spread · node Adept-active (Watch) · Reverie ground.
*Ecology.* The colony's guano bed under the hill's cave smolders since the Namaris fires and any spark on the hill spreads; two terrace fires this phase, and a hearth that took a roof. Sign: a hillside where a dropped lamp is a field fire, and the cave mouth warm.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage 1, Move 14, flying). *Enhancement:* within a Circle of 20 paces of any bat of the colony, fire spreads — Burning passes to any adjacent creature at the start of its turn and takes two Moves to smother, not one; any flame struck on the hill catches.
*Dependency.* The guano bed, a hand's depth of smolder under the roost. Found by Element at Adept grade (fire answers underground, in the cave, and will next turn) or by the terrace lineage, who have felt the cave mouth.
*Disruption.* Flood the cave — the terrace lineage's water, carried up a day by forty people; or Elemental *Still* (fire) at 16, held three turns, in the cave, under the colony; or dig the bed out, two days, in smoke, Sickened.
*After.* Bats over a hill that burns like any hill.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): fire underground; the bed. Life (Adept): the colony, well; what it needs is the cave, not the fire. Make: nothing here — no one set it. Field — Seams: where the cave mouth breaks, which would bury the bed and the colony and is the hill's road-keeper's proposal.
*Records.* The terrace lineages: two fires, one roof. The speaker-circle's docket: the road-keeper's proposal, heard, the cave's lineage objecting on the ground that the cave is a duty and not a fire.

### 3.10 Teocalli — Yamana · Gold Crown · Deciduous Forest, Grassland, Chaparral

Tepemitla (forest hill seat; the Crown's ritual heartland), Amilpan (irrigated grassland), Xalcoyan (chaparral scrub town). Ceiling Adept. Ethos: Devout, over terrace water customs and road law. The precincts file beasts as stock lost on the tithe roll and tithe the remainder; a beast on the precinct's own spring or the causeway is a doctrinal matter before it is a hunt, because the road is the god's count and the spring is the Steward's, and the precinct has never diverted its own water for anything.

**Xalcoyan file-puma, Threnis 1244** — Novice · puma · Chaparral × Threnis: ambush predator magnification · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A puma in the scrub above the town that takes the last goat of any file driven up the scrub path at dusk. Sign: a file that comes home one short, always the last.
*Block.* Guard 14 · Vigor 14 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12. *Amplified trait:* from concealment its first attack has Favor and deals +Rank Die; everyone in its Circle is Surprised in the first round unless on *Watch*.
*Rigidity.* The last animal of a file, at dusk, on the scrub path. *Exploit:* the file; a goat last and a spear behind it, or no file at dusk, which is what the town does.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the lie above the path, at 5 paces. Field — Weight: it commits to the last. Life: well.
*Records.* The precinct's tithe roll: goats, by the head, lost. The town: the same, and the hour.

**Amilpan turn-flock, Saelura 1244** — Novice · wild turkey (a flock of forty) · Irrigated grassland × Saelura: soil recovery · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A flock on the recovered irrigation margins that strips the seedlings of whichever field's water turn has just run. Sign: a field watered at dawn and stripped by noon; the flock a field ahead of the turn roll.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d6, Move 10, flying short). *Amplified trait:* numbers; the flock strips a field's seedlings in an hour.
*Rigidity.* Follows the water turns in the order the precinct's Namaris-circuit calendar allots them. *Exploit:* the turn roll; a field watered out of order draws the flock to a field with nothing in it, which the precinct will not allot and the terrace lineages have done anyway, twice, quietly.
*Layers.* Life (Novice): well, and full. Element (Novice): water answers in the field the turn just ran. Field — Geometry: the flock's corridor is the calendar.
*Records.* The precinct's irrigation-turn roll and its seedling losses, tithed. The lineages' count, the same, without the tithe.

**Tepemitla growth-nest, Velquor 1244** — Novice · hornet (a nest) · Deciduous forest hill × Velquor: geometric growth · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A nest in a tree at the precinct's forest edge that doubles each phase in the same tree and now fills the crown; the precinct's road-sweeping procession passed under it in Velquor and lost three sweepers to stings. Sign: a crown that hums, and a tree twice the size of its neighbors' load.
*Block.* Run a disturbed nest as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage d4 + Poisoned (d4 a turn until Reserve 13), Move 12, flying). *Amplified trait:* growth — the nest's Cohesion is 6 in Velquor, 12 by Saelura, and 20 by Orrivane if it stands.
*Rigidity.* The same tree; the nest never divides. *Exploit:* the tree, felled in Saelura before the growth, at night, in smoke — a morning's work for the precinct's laborers, who have asked the precinct to fell it and been told the tree is on the god's road.
*Layers.* Structure (Novice): a mass in the crown, growing. Life (Novice): many, well, and more. Field — Seams: where the crown breaks, which is where the nest's weight is.
*Records.* The precinct roll: three sweepers, unable to sweep, filed as a lapse of duty and forgiven. The laborers' count: the tree's girth, each phase.

**Xalcoyan spring-rattlers, Saelura 1244** — Novice · rattlesnake (a gathering at a spring) · Chaparral × Saelura: spring resurgence · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A spring below the scrub town that came back in Saelura, and the snakes gathered at it; the town's goats will not water there and two children have been bitten. Sign: the spring's south stones moving at midday.
*Block.* Small; a disturbed gathering as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 14, attack d20 + 3, damage d4 + Poisoned (d6 a turn until Reserve 13, or a Novice purgative), Move 6). *Amplified trait:* the venom, at d6.
*Rigidity.* Bask on the south stones at midday; in the water's shade at every other hour. *Exploit:* the hour; water at dawn, or shade the south stones with a hurdle, which moves the gathering to the next sunlit stone and the next, until there is none. A day's work.
*Layers.* Life (Novice): many, warm. Element (Novice): water answers; it will hold. Field — Ground: the shaded approach.
*Records.* The town's count: two children, one dead. The precinct roll: the spring as the Steward's, restored, and the snakes as the cost of a restoration, which the town has heard read and not accepted.

**Tepemitla jaguar, Saelura 1244** — Adept · jaguar · Deciduous forest hill × Saelura: rapid healing · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A jaguar in the precinct's forest that drinks at the spring below the precinct wall before every hunt and whose wounds close between turns; it has killed two precinct laborers and a Paladin of the escort. Sign: a jaguar's prints at the spring the precinct's rites are drawn from.
*Block.* Large: Guard 14 · Vigor 24 · attack +2 + d6 · bite d10 + 2 + Rank Die · Move 12, climbs at full Move. *Enhancement:* regains Rank Die Vigor at the start of each turn within the hill's forest; its first attack from concealment deals +Rank Die.
*Dependency.* The precinct's spring, which reads Saelura-active and feeds the irrigation-turn rites. Found by Element at Adept grade (water answers; the spring is the thing) or by Life (what the jaguar needs: the spring, before the hunt).
*Disruption.* Divert the spring — Elemental *Shape* (water) at 16, three casts, or the precinct's laborers with picks in a day — which the precinct has refused: the spring is the Steward's and the rites are drawn from it. Nature *Quiet*, held a scene, stops the jaguar and not the spring. The Apostle's route is a *Boon* on the hunters and a hunt at the spring in the turn before the jaguar regains, which the precinct has blessed.
*After.* A jaguar, on the Novice block, which is enough.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): water answers; the spring's next turn is the same. Life (Adept): the spring, before the hunt. Intent: fear on the laborers; resolve on the escort, which is the Boon's. Boundary (Adept): three, this phase, violent.
*Records.* The precinct roll: two laborers, one Paladin. The Assay's room at Tepemitla: the Boon certified, the hunt pending.

**Amilpan ring-warren, Velquor 1244** — Adept · pocket gopher (a colony) · Irrigated grassland × Velquor: ring necrosis · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A colony whose warren spreads rings of dead maize across the irrigated fields; inside a ring nothing recovers — a laborer who sleeps in one wakes no better. Sign: circles in the maize, dead to the root, and a channel that runs through one and comes out dry.
*Block.* Soldiers, if dug into: a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d4, Move 4). *Enhancement:* inside a ring, plants die, Vigor does not recover at rest, and *Channel Work* restores half; a ring widens a pace a night.
*Dependency.* The warren's center under the oldest ring, where the ground reads a crossing — something died there, old, several; the necrosis grows from it. Found by Boundary at Adept grade (the register and the time: several, forty years, empty — the Edict's year, which the reading gives as a season and the Necromancer must not be asked to say more) or by Structure (the warren's chamber, precise).
*Disruption.* Dig out the center and re-lay the irrigation channel across it — Elemental *Shape* (water) at 16, two casts, and a day's labor by the terrace lineage whose field it is; or Arcane *Precise Force* on the chamber at 16. A Necrotic practitioner on Crown ground reading the center is a Purge matter, and the terrace lineage knows one across the causeway in Kinha who would not come.
*After.* Gophers, which the fields have always had.
*Layers.* Boundary (Adept): several, a season forty years back, empty. Structure (Adept): the chamber. Life (Adept): dying, in rings; what the maize needs is water across the center. Intent: nothing here; the lineage's silence, which the Divine reader returns as resolve.
*Records.* The precinct's irrigation-turn roll: fields lost, tithed. The lineage's count: the rings, and the year the center was last dug, which the lineage does not say.

### 3.11 Bahr-Al-Asra — Unsaan · Gold Crown · Savanna, Desert, Deciduous Forest

Marj-Al-Sidr (savanna meadow seat), Qasr-Al-Rimal (desert citadel; pontifical seat), Bab-Al-Ghaf (forest gate town). Ceiling Adept. Ethos: Devout, under guest-right and shade-and-water servitudes. The arbiter-judges' bite roll for the Bahr Sufra is the citadel's beast record; the caravan houses keep their own; the gate at Bab-Al-Ghaf taxes hardwood and counts what the forest costs it. A beast in a wall's shade is on the road's ground, not the wall's owner's, and the servitude decides who answers for it.

**Sufra shade-viper, Orrivane 1244** — Novice · horned viper · Desert road × Orrivane: heat delirium · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A viper that buries itself in the midday shade-line of the road walls, where the servitude puts every walker, and whose bite brings the road's heat into the head. Sign: a walker sitting in the shade talking to no one.
*Block.* Small: Guard 15 · Vigor 6 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d4 + 1 + Rank Die (Poisoned: −2 on all checks and Notice at Hindrance from delirium until Reserve 13, or a Novice purgative) · Move 6. *Amplified trait:* the venom's delirium.
*Rigidity.* The shade-line at midday; the sun side never. *Exploit:* walk the sun side at midday, which every child on the Sufra knows and every guest does not; the arbiter-judges have posted it and the servitude still puts the shade on the road.
*Layers.* Structure (Novice): one small mass under sand, at the line. Make: nothing here; the delirium is not a dose. Life: warm, coiled.
*Records.* The arbiter-judges' bite roll: eleven, three of them guests within their three nights, whose hosts answered.

**Sidr fire-hyenas, Namaris 1244** — Novice · striped hyena (a pack of five) · Savanna meadow × Namaris: grass fire · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A pack that follows the Namaris grass fires across the fig meadows and takes the goats that run from them. Sign: hyenas on the burned side of a fire at dawn.
*Block.* Five on one initiative: Guard 12 · Vigor 12 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12. *Amplified trait:* its laugh — the first time each scene the pack is within 10 paces, Frightened on a Reserve check at 10.
*Rigidity.* The fire's lee edge, at dawn, the burned side. *Exploit:* burn a strip early, at dusk — the orchard households' own fire, on their own ground, which draws the pack to a lee with nothing on it and the goats penned behind the strip.
*Layers.* Element (Novice): fire, and which side is lee. Field — Weight: the pack commits to what runs. Life: fed.
*Records.* The orchard households' hospitality ledgers, which count goats fed to guests and not goats lost, and so record the loss as a guest not fed.

**Ghaf gate-porcupine, Saelura 1244** — Novice · crested porcupine · Forest gate × Saelura: rapid healing · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A porcupine that gnaws the gate's hardwood stacks nightly and has been clubbed twice, and came back whole. Sign: stacked hardwood gnawed at the butt, and quills in the gate dog.
*Block.* Small: Guard 15 · Vigor 10 · attack +1 + d4 · quills d6 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 6. *Amplified trait:* regains d4 Vigor at the start of each turn; anyone who misses it in melee takes d4 from the quills.
*Rigidity.* The stacks, nightly, from the forest side, and it takes bark before wood. *Exploit:* bark — a heap of felled bark on the forest side of the gate, a cart's worth, which it gnaws instead, and a spear thrown from the stack's shadow before it regains.
*Layers.* Field — Seams (Novice): where the stack breaks, which is where it has been. Life: well, whole. Field — Ground: the forest-side approach.
*Records.* The gate's hardwood tax ledger: stacks reduced, by the ell, taxed anyway.

**Rimal draw-hour ibex, Saelura 1244** — Novice · Nubian ibex (a herd of twelve) · Desert citadel × Saelura: oasis stabilization · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A herd at the citadel's outer well, which held in Saelura, that comes to the public draw-hours exactly and walks the outer wall's footing at dawn. Sign: ibex on the wall at first light, and at the well when the bell rings the draw.
*Block.* Guard 13 · Vigor 14 · attack +1 + d4 · horn d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12, climbs anything. *Amplified trait:* footing — never Prone, never Stuck, climbs a wall at full Move.
*Rigidity.* The draw-hours, to the bell, and the wall at dawn. *Exploit:* the draw-hours; a second bell rung early empties the well of people and fills it with ibex, and the citadel's hunters, who may not draw on the well's ground at the public hour, may at any other. The Scribe's room has ruled on which hour that is.
*Layers.* Element (Novice): water answers; stable. Field — Ground: the wall is its road. Life: well.
*Records.* The well's draw-hour roll, kept by the citadel's household, which counts the herd as drawing.

**Sufra wrong-way string, Orrivane 1244** — Novice · dromedary (a feral string of nine) · Savanna road × Orrivane: migration reversal · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* Nine camels walking the Bahr Sufra against the caravan strings, on the road's exact line, and a string that meets them is a string tangled for an hour. Sign: camels coming the wrong way with no drover.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 11, attack d20 + 3, damage d10 + 1, Move 8). *Amplified trait:* Frame; the string does not leave the road for anything it can push through, and a Line or string it meets makes a Cohesion check at 13 or is tangled a turn.
*Rigidity.* The road's line, against traffic, from the Grimskov-grain ford eastward, and it turns back at the citadel's shade-line. *Exploit:* the ford; the houses' outriders turn the string at the ford into the meadow, where it grazes and forgets the road for a phase. Two houses have done this and each records the other as having failed.
*Layers.* Field — Geometry (Novice): the road is the corridor and the string will not leave it. Field — Nerve: holds; turns. Life: fed, unridden, unbranded.
*Records.* Two caravan houses' ledgers, one entry each, which disagree on the count and on whose string it was; neither says nine.

**Ghaf sap-leopard, Saelura 1244** — Adept · leopard · Forest gate × Saelura: rapid healing · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A leopard in the ghaf stands on the gate road whose wounds close, that hunts the road's shade at the hour the servitude fills it; it has taken a hardwood cutter and a guest in his second night, whose host answered. Sign: a leopard's drag-mark from the shade-line into the stand.
*Block.* Large: Guard 14 · Vigor 24 · attack +2 + d6 · bite d10 + 2 + Rank Die · Move 12, climbs at full Move. *Enhancement:* regains Rank Die Vigor at the start of each turn within 100 paces of the stand; from the stand's shade its first attack has Favor.
*Dependency.* A stand of ghaf on the road whose sap runs in Saelura; the leopard lies in it and feeds on what feeds on it. Found by Life at Adept grade by contact with a stripped trunk (what the body needs: the stand) or by Element (water answers in the wood).
*Disruption.* Tap the stand dry — a day's work by the gate's cutters — or fell it, which the gate's hardwood tax would pay for and the town will not permit: the stand's shade is the road's by servitude, and cutting shade trees on the road is a thing the town does not do and does not call religious (Canon Part VII, Umm-Al-Ghaf). The parish wants the cull; the town wants the shade; the Apostle's route is a hunt in the turn before it regains.
*After.* A leopard, on the Novice block, in a stand that still shades the road.
*Layers.* Life (Adept): the stand. Element (Adept): water in the wood. Boundary (Adept): two, this phase, violent, one of them a guest, which the reading gives as confused. Intent: the host's shame, which the Divine reader returns as fear; the parish's resolve.
*Records.* The gate's tax ledger: one cutter's household. The host's hospitality ledger: one guest, answered for, read aloud at the turn. The parish roll: two, tithed against.

**Rimal shadow-falcon, Velquor 1244** — Adept · falcon · Desert flat × Velquor: mirages · node Adept-active (Watch) · Devout ground.
*Ecology.* A falcon that hunts the salt flat south of the citadel by the doubled horizon; its shadow arrives before it does, and what looks up at the shadow is taken from the other side. It has struck two of the Chancel's couriers off their horses. Sign: a shadow on the flat with nothing over it.
*Block.* Small: Guard 16 · Vigor 10 · attack +2 + d6 · talon d6 + 2 + Rank Die · Move 18, flying. *Enhancement:* everyone in its Circle is Surprised each round it attacks from the mirage; its attacks from it have Favor; a Structure reading held gives the true position and ends the Surprise for the reader.
*Dependency.* The flat's crust, which holds the mirage's doubled horizon; the falcon hunts by it and only there. Found by Element at Adept grade (light answers on the crust, and nowhere off it) or by Structure (the crust's composition, precise, and a reading that is not salt's).
*Disruption.* Break the crust — a stone sledge dragged across the flat's mile, a day, six camels; or Elemental *Shape* (ground) at 16, four casts; or wait for Saelura, which the couriers' master has proposed and the Chancel has declined, having letters.
*After.* A falcon over a flat, which the citadel's falconers, if it has any, would want, and the module does not say it has.
*Layers.* Element (Adept): light answers on the crust. Structure (Adept): the crust is not salt; the falcon's true position. Field — Weight: it commits to what looks up. Intent: the couriers' fear, at the flat's edge.
*Records.* The Scribe's room: two couriers, their letters recovered, the delay entered. The couriers' master: two horses, not recovered.

### 3.12 Zand-Kala — Unsaan · Blue Accord · Savanna, Grassland, Deciduous Forest

Dasht-Anar (grassland plain seat), Sabz-Rud (forest river town), Bagh-Shirin (savanna garden town). Ceiling Novice: a dormant node, the only one on the map. Ethos: Rationalist, through garden councils under Accord examination. A beast is a stock-ledger loss and a cull licence at Kalani contract rates, drawn by the best lawyers on either continent and priced accordingly. The Watch's figure and the councils' losses do not agree, and Zand-Kala has counsel for that.

**Dasht-Anar boundary-eagle, Threnis 1244** — Novice · steppe eagle · Grassland plain × Threnis: burrow and raptor apex · node Novice (dormant; Watch) · Rationalist ground.
*Ecology.* An eagle that hunts the plain's irrigation-share boundaries from the boundary stones and takes lambs and a hare a day. Sign: an eagle on a share-stone, and the shares' hares gone.
*Block.* Guard 14 · Vigor 12 · attack +1 + d4 · talon d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 16, flying. *Amplified trait:* from above, Favor to hit and +Rank Die.
*Rigidity.* The boundary stones only, in the order of the council's allotment survey, one a day. *Exploit:* the stones; the survey gives tomorrow's stone, and a net over it. The council's surveyor charged for the copy.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the stone it will use, from the survey, not the reading. Field — Weight: it commits from the stone. Life: well.
*Records.* The garden council's stock ledger: lambs, by allotment. The Ledger's licence: Warden, Novice, 2 seals, Threnis price.

**Shirin smoke-jackals, Namaris 1244** — Novice · golden jackal (a pair) · Savanna garden town × Namaris: grass fire · node Novice (dormant; Watch) · Rationalist ground.
*Ecology.* A pair that raids the garden compounds under the Namaris grass-fire smoke, by the water gates, and takes fowl and once a lamb. Sign: a water gate open in the smoke, and prints in the wet.
*Block.* Small: Guard 15 · Vigor 8 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d4 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12 each, on one initiative. *Amplified trait:* in smoke they are concealed and their attacks have Favor.
*Rigidity.* The water gate, in smoke, never the wall. *Exploit:* the gate; a gate barred at the first smoke and a spear behind it. The council has ruled that the water gate is the irrigation share's and not the compound's, and the share-holder bars it.
*Layers.* Element (Novice): smoke, upwind; the fire's edge. Field — Geometry: the gate is the corridor. Life: fed.
*Records.* The compounds' stock ledgers, by irrigation share. The council's ruling, at Kalani rates.

**Sabz-Rud ford-sounder, Orrivane 1244** — Novice · wild boar (a sounder of nine) · Forest river × Orrivane: herd agitation · node Novice (dormant; Watch) · Rationalist ground.
*Ecology.* A sounder that crosses the river at the town's ford at dusk and sends the garden oxen off the road every time; two carts in the river this phase. Sign: oxen backing on the ford road at dusk.
*Block.* Run as a Squad Line (Cohesion 6, Guard 12, attack d20 + 3, damage d10 + 1, Move 10). *Amplified trait:* draft animals within 20 paces bolt on a Reserve check at 13.
*Rigidity.* The ford, at dusk, from the far bank. *Exploit:* the ford; the town's carts cross an hour early, and a Warden on the near bank at dusk has the sounder in the water where its Cohesion is 4.
*Layers.* Field — Geometry (Novice): the ford is the corridor. Field — Weight: the sounder commits when the far bank is empty. Life: well.
*Records.* The council's cart-loss ledger. The Ledger's licence, unissued: the river is a shared title and the council's lawyers are still on whose.

**Dasht-Anar rise-wolf, Orrivane 1244** — Novice · wolf, lone · Grassland plain × Orrivane: herd agitation · node Novice (dormant; Watch) · Rationalist ground.
*Ecology.* A lone wolf that howls from one rise on the plain at the same hour and every herd within a mile bolts; it takes what breaks a leg. Sign: a howl at the hour, and the plain moving.
*Block.* Guard 13 · Vigor 14 · attack +1 + d4 · bite d8 + 1 + Rank Die · Move 12. *Amplified trait:* the howl — herds and Lines within 100 paces make a Cohesion check at 13 or scatter; mounts bolt on Reserve 13.
*Rigidity.* The rise, the hour, alone. *Exploit:* the rise, at the hour, with an archer on it first. The council's licence names the rise and the hour and the fee.
*Layers.* Field — Ground (Novice): the rise, its one approach from the plain. Field — Nerve: it holds on the rise; breaks off it. Life: well, alone.
*Records.* The council's stock ledger: legs, by share. The Ledger's licence: Warden, Novice, 2 seals; the council's counsel has appended a note that the Watch's dormant reading is inconsistent with a howl that moves a plain, and the Ledger has filed the note as anecdotal.

## 4. Rolling a ground's beasts

For a ground the roll above did not cover, or a new phase. The steps are the Generation Procedure (Canon Part VIII) as dice; every result is a candidate XI.3 row and goes in the episode's or the session's ratification register.

### Count, by ground and phase

| Tier | Roll | Condition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Novice | 1d4 + 1 standing on any working ground; 1d3 new per phase | — |
| Adept | 1d3 standing; d6, 5–6 = one new per phase | Ceiling Adept or higher |
| Master | d6, 4–6 = one standing on the homeland; d12, 12 = one new per year | Ceiling Master; the Threnis phase on 8 in 12 |
| Guru | d4 once per map per campaign: 1 none; 2–3 one rising; 4 two | Off-scale reading; a campaign event; enter it as a Watch entry |

### Moon at emergence

d5 (a d10 halved, rounded up): 1 Velquor, 2 Saelura, 3 Orrivane, 4 Namaris, 5 Threnis. Master tier: 1–8 on a d12 is Threnis; 9–12 the others in order. The moon fixes the column; read the cell; the cell is the beast's ambient effect and the source of its trait, enhancement, dominance, or domain.

### Base animal

The fauna of the ground. These are examples of what lives there, not species of beast; any animal of the biome and the culture's daily life serves, and the mounts and draft animals of Canon Part I are fauna too.

| Biome | Fauna of the ground (examples) |
|:--|:--|
| Tundra | musk ox, reindeer, arctic fox, hare, ptarmigan, raven, seal on the coast |
| Taiga | wolf, boar, lynx, bear, elk, beaver, marten, owl, dhole in Renlei country |
| Evergreen | bear, leopard or tiger in Renlei country, boar, deer, macaque, heron on the coast |
| Deciduous forest | deer, jaguar or ocelot in Yamana country, leopard in Unsaan country, bat, hornet, boar, porcupine |
| Grassland | horse, wild ass, buffalo, gazelle, hawk, eagle, vole, gopher, turkey, peccary |
| Savanna | cattle, lion, hyena, jackal, wildebeest, oryx, ostrich, termite |
| Desert | camel, jackal, viper, scorpion, monitor, ibex, coyote, armadillo, vulture, falcon |
| Chaparral | puma, leopard, python, rattlesnake, goat, quail |
| Tropical rainforest | pig, eel, crab, flying fox, moth, mosquito, heron, harrier on the grassland edge, shark and otter on the water |

### Trait, dependency, reversal, tether

Prompts, one per tier. Roll d6 or choose.

| d6 | Novice trait | Novice rigidity | Adept dependency | Adept enhancement |
|:-:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Speed (Move +4) | A route | A spring or waterhole (Element) | A cell as a Circle (smoke, storm, drift, fire) |
| 2 | Concealment in the cell | An hour | A den, roost, or nest site whose reading is off (Structure) | Regeneration, Rank Die a turn |
| 3 | Regeneration d4 | A target (the last, the loudest, the light) | A stand, a lick, a bush, a run (Life) | A Frightening display |
| 4 | A bite or horn one die up | A return (the same tree, step, skerry) | A carcass ground or dead-ground (Boundary) | Agitation: herds and mounts bolt |
| 5 | Footing (never Stuck or Prone) | A refusal (will not leave, cross, or pursue) | A crust, bar, or outcrop (Structure) | Disorientation: bearings fail |
| 6 | Numbers (a Line) | A following (one animal leads) | A fire line or peat bed (Element) | Rot, venom, or sickness beyond an animal's |

Master: the dominance is the cell at strength wherever the beast is; the inversion is the cell's opposite phase (Saelura for most, Namaris for a chaparral or grassland cover, Velquor for a herd-beast); the reversal is a phase-scale operation that produces the inversion on purpose — a burn, a flood, a well, a closure. Guru: the domain is a Ground; the tether is a terrain feature's node; the displacement is engineering or closure ending in a Join at 30. Write the Guru as a Watch entry first and a rule second.

### Records

Every beast has two counts. Roll d6 for the second counter: 1 a parish or precinct roll; 2 a Ledger licence or assessment; 3 a Concord docket or a keeper's closure; 4 a caravan house, timber house, or fish-house ledger; 5 a moot, council, or lineage count; 6 the Watch's phase entry, which is a reading and not a sighting.

## 5. Design decisions register

Choices in this module that touch canon, listed for ratification in the pattern of GMG §11. Rejecting a row changes what it names and nothing else. Every beast entry is a candidate XI.3 row; none is entered.

| # | Decision | Where | Note |
|:-:|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | R.8 "Full bestiary" is read as forbidding species lists and not registers of emergences; this module's entries are emergences in XI.3 form, each with base animal, biome, moon, node reading, and tier | Front matter; §3 | The reading that permits the module. If rejected, the 71 entries stand as worked examples of the Generation Procedure and are not candidates for XI.3 |
| 2 | Beast blocks by tier, calibrated against GMG §7 practitioner blocks; size adjustments; beasts carry no Strain or Marks | §2, Blocks | Replaces the GMG's interim rule for beasts only |
| 3 | Ethos is expressed as the record — how the ground's institution files and handles a beast — and not as a change to the beast's body | §1, formula, item 4 | Canon says ethos shapes emergence and not how. The Part VIII worked example's "the Ledger will file the cull as a licensed contract" is the model. Rejecting this leaves ethos unexpressed, as canon leaves it |

**Context-size note.** This module is about 25,500 words (roughly 34k tokens). The routine beast load for a session is section 2 plus the homeland the party is on (about 2,500–3,500 words); the full file is for a session that rolls new grounds or ratifies rows.
